domain.name: ISO 27001:2022
domain.description: International standard for information security management systems (ISMS).

coreQuestions.question: Is there a documented information security policy?
coreQuestions.description: The organization shall define, document, and maintain an information security policy.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Information security policy document with approval signatures and revision history.

coreQuestions.question: Is the information security policy reviewed at planned intervals?
coreQuestions.description: The information security policy shall be reviewed at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Policy review records showing scheduled reviews and management sign-off.

coreQuestions.question: Are information security roles and responsibilities defined?
coreQuestions.description: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: RACI matrix or job descriptions with clear security responsibilities.

coreQuestions.question: Are information security roles segregated to reduce conflict of interest?
coreQuestions.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Segregation of duties matrix and access control documentation.

coreQuestions.question: Are assets inventoried and tracked?
coreQuestions.description: All assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be maintained.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Complete asset inventory with classification, location, and ownership.

coreQuestions.question: Are assets classified and labeled?
coreQuestions.description: Information shall be classified in accordance with the organization's information classification scheme.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Information classification policy and examples of labeled assets.

coreQuestions.question: Is access control policy defined and enforced?
coreQuestions.description: An access control policy shall be defined, documented, and reviewed based on business and information security requirements.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Access control policy with user registration, review, and revocation procedures.

coreQuestions.question: Are users registered and de-registered for access to systems?
coreQuestions.description: A formal user registration and de-registration procedure shall be implemented to enable assignment of access rights.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: User provisioning and de-provisioning procedures with audit logs.

coreQuestions.question: Are access rights reviewed periodically?
coreQuestions.description: Access rights shall be reviewed at regular intervals using a formal process.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Quarterly access review reports with remediation tracking.

coreQuestions.question: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for privileged access?
coreQuestions.description: Multi-factor authentication shall be used for all privileged access to systems and applications.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: MFA configuration screenshots and enforcement policy.

coreQuestions.question: Is encryption of data at rest implemented?
coreQuestions.description: Appropriate cryptographic controls shall be used to protect data at rest.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Encryption policy and configuration evidence for databases, storage, and backups.

coreQuestions.question: Is encryption of data in transit implemented?
coreQuestions.description: Cryptographic controls shall be used to protect data in transit over networks.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: TLS configuration, certificate management, and network diagram showing encrypted paths.

coreQuestions.question: Are physical security perimeters defined and enforced?
coreQuestions.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and information processing facilities.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Physical security controls including access card systems, CCTV, and visitor logs.

coreQuestions.question: Are operational procedures documented and available?
coreQuestions.description: Operating procedures shall be documented and made available to all users who need them.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Standard operating procedures for critical systems and processes.

coreQuestions.question: Are backups of information performed and tested regularly?
coreQuestions.description: Backups of information, software, and system images shall be taken and tested regularly.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Backup schedule, retention policy, and quarterly restore test results.

coreQuestions.question: Are vulnerability scans performed on a regular basis?
coreQuestions.description: Technical vulnerabilities shall be identified, evaluated, and remediated in a timely manner.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Vulnerability scan reports, remediation tracking, and SLA adherence.

coreQuestions.question: Are network security controls implemented?
coreQuestions.description: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Network architecture diagram, firewall rules, and segmentation controls.

coreQuestions.question: Is incident management process defined and tested?
coreQuestions.description: Responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective, and orderly response to information security incidents.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Incident response plan, tabletop exercise results, and incident log.

coreQuestions.question: Are lessons learned from incidents documented and acted upon?
coreQuestions.description: Knowledge gained from analyzing and resolving information security incidents shall be used to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Post-incident review reports with improvement action items.

coreQuestions.question: Is a secure software development lifecycle followed?
coreQuestions.description: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Secure SDLC policy covering code review, testing, and deployment.

coreQuestions.question: Is change management process implemented?
coreQuestions.description: Changes to the organization, business processes, information processing facilities, and systems that affect information security shall be controlled.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Change management policy, change request forms, and approval records.

coreQuestions.question: Are supplier security requirements defined and enforced?
coreQuestions.description: Information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplier access to the organization's assets shall be agreed with the supplier.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Supplier security assessment records and contractual security clauses.

coreQuestions.question: Is business continuity plan established and tested?
coreQuestions.description: Business continuity shall be addressed through plans that ensure the organization can maintain or recover operations in a timely manner.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Business continuity plan with DR procedures and test results.

coreQuestions.question: Are business continuity plans tested regularly?
coreQuestions.description: Business continuity plans shall be tested periodically to ensure they are valid and effective.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: BCP test schedules, scenarios, and post-exercise reports.

coreQuestions.question: Is there a disciplinary process for security violations?
coreQuestions.description: A formal disciplinary process shall be in place for employees who have committed information security violations.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: HR disciplinary policy including information security violations.

coreQuestions.question: Are compliance obligations identified and tracked?
coreQuestions.description: All relevant legislative, regulatory, and contractual requirements shall be identified and documented.
coreQuestions.expectedEvidence: Compliance register with applicable obligations and review dates.

saas.question: Is API access authenticated and rate-limited?
saas.description: APIs shall be secured with authentication mechanisms and rate limiting to prevent abuse.
saas.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + SaaS Best Practices
saas.expectedEvidence: API gateway configuration with auth tokens and rate limit policies.

saas.question: Is secure deployment pipeline configured?
saas.description: Deployment pipelines shall include security checks, code signing, and automated testing.
saas.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + SaaS Best Practices
saas.expectedEvidence: CI/CD pipeline configuration with integrated security scanning steps.

saas.question: Are third-party integrations assessed for security?
saas.description: All third-party integrations and SaaS dependencies shall be assessed for security posture.
saas.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + SaaS Best Practices
saas.expectedEvidence: Third-party integration inventory with security assessment scores.

fintech.question: Is PCI-DSS compliance maintained for payment data?
fintech.description: Payment card data processing shall comply with PCI-DSS requirements.
fintech.expectedEvidence: PCI-DSS attestation of compliance and scope documentation.

fintech.question: Is transaction monitoring and fraud detection implemented?
fintech.description: Real-time transaction monitoring and fraud detection controls shall be in place.
fintech.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + Fintech Best Practices
fintech.expectedEvidence: Transaction monitoring system configuration and sample alerts.

healthcare.question: Is patient data handled in compliance with HIPAA/regulations?
healthcare.description: Patient health information shall be protected in accordance with applicable healthcare regulations.
healthcare.expectedEvidence: Data handling procedures and regulatory compliance documentation.

healthcare.question: Are medical devices and IoT endpoints secured?
healthcare.description: Medical devices and IoT endpoints connected to the network shall be identified and secured.
healthcare.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + Healthcare Best Practices
healthcare.expectedEvidence: Medical device inventory with security configuration and patch status.

ecommerce.question: Are payment pages secured against skimming and injection?
ecommerce.description: E-commerce payment pages shall be protected against client-side skimming and code injection attacks.
ecommerce.expectedEvidence: CSP headers, subresource integrity, and payment form security review.

ecommerce.question: Is inventory management system access controlled?
ecommerce.description: Access to inventory management systems shall be restricted and monitored.
ecommerce.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + E-commerce Best Practices
ecommerce.expectedEvidence: Inventory system access logs and role-based access configuration.

enterprise.question: Are remote access and VPN connections secured?
enterprise.description: Remote access to the corporate network shall be secured through VPN and endpoint compliance checks.
enterprise.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + Enterprise Best Practices
enterprise.expectedEvidence: VPN configuration, remote access policy, and endpoint compliance reports.

enterprise.question: Are internal data classification and handling procedures enforced?
enterprise.description: Internal data handling procedures based on classification shall be enforced across all departments.
enterprise.source: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A + Enterprise Best Practices
enterprise.expectedEvidence: Data handling SOPs by classification level and department training records.
